_meta.datasheet_section: Section 5 PW top-view diagram (authoritative) + Pin Functions; 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions
_meta.notes: Datasheet Pin Functions table lists 8=3A, 9=3B, 11=4A, 12=4B, which contradicts its own PW/RGY top-view drawing and the standard '125 pinout (8=3B, 9=3A, 11=4B, 12=4A). Drawing followed. A/B are symmetric FET-switch terminals, so the consequence is naming only. Top mark KS125. [height] 1.2 mm max: DS PW0014A outline: 1.2 MAX. [temp] DS 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions: TA −40…85 °C
